caption: Korean toddler Gyeran Mari 🇰🇷🍳 Whenever I make gyeran mari (Korean rolled eggs), it brings back childhood memories 🥹 It’s such a classic Korean side dish, and now I love getting to make a simple toddler-friendly version for my daughter. Ingredients: 🥚 3 eggs 🥕 Finely chopped carrots 🌱 Finely chopped green onions 🧄 Sprinkle of garlic powder 🫒 Olive oil for the pan Whisk the eggs, then mix in the carrots, green onions, and garlic powder. Cook on low-medium heat in a lightly oiled pan. Pour in a thin layer of the egg mixture, fold one end over and begin rolling. Push the roll to one side, add more egg mixture, and continue rolling until you’ve used it all. Let it cool, then slice into toddler-friendly pieces! I served hers with little rice balls she could easily grab and eat. 🍚🤍 A little piece of my childhood, now on her plate. 🥹🇰🇷 #toddlerrecipes #toddlermeals #koreanfood #easyrecipe #toddlerfood
